description: Java class 'CommandAndControlClient' that manages AMQP command and control communication for Hono, including establishing connections, receiving commands, and sending responses.

classes.name: CommandAndControlClient
classes.description: A Spring component that manages AMQP command and control messaging for Hono, including receiving commands and sending responses.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the command receiver and handles incoming command messages, sending responses or logging one-way commands.

methods.name: startCommandReceiver
methods.description: Establishes connection to the AMQP adapter and creates a sender for command responses.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Creates a receiver link to listen for commands from the specified endpoint and sets up message handling.
